device.name: AMD Radeon Pro V620
device.clocks: host defaults; no clock or power settings changed

geometry.context_definition: cells visible to the first query; subsequent queries see one more cell each

timing.units: microseconds per window per attention layer, on one card
timing.warm: median of 8 hipEvent samples, each replaying 16 captured calls
timing.cold: median of 12 hipEvent samples, one captured call after a 256 MiB read-modify-write eviction kernel; eviction excluded
timing.new: k_attn_part_rows, fixed grid (64,nt*H/4), live device position selects groups of 4 or 8 heads
timing.head_short: original k_attn_part<false>, fixed grid (4,nt*H), measured only where the short dispatch applies
timing.total_columns: partial kernel plus unchanged k_attn_merge; warm measurements are separate samples, not sums of other columns
timing.phase_caveat: ablation kernels have different register allocation; timings are not additive and separate passes can vary

shipped_compiler_resources.source: standalone test device assembly using the shared production header and HIP Release flags

launch_bound_comparison.alternative: explicit 256-thread launch bound, 131 VGPRs, zero private bytes
launch_bound_comparison.decision: retain the small spill and measured faster aggregate throughput

parity.graph: eight changing-position replays per graph case; crosses 256-cell and 1024-cell group-size boundaries
parity.fallbacks: STREAM ring wrap, prefetch, rollback guard, RowSel cells/slots/cache tables and per-slot hot tables; STREAM also compared against the non-stream cold-cache reference
math_order: Each score retains one FP32 accumulation chain over dimensions 0..255, followed by scaling.
Max and sum retain the original descending-stride 256-leaf tree, folded across registers, LDS and wave shuffles.
Each output dimension retains one FP32 V accumulation chain over cells 0..n-1.

dispatch.default: gfx1030 wave32, int8, HD256, H=16*HKV, non-stream, non-RowSel; existing GQA disable switch respected
dispatch.enable: unset or STRATA_Q36_ATTN_ROWS=1 on the eligible geometry/device
dispatch.group_size: 4 heads through 1024 cells, 8 heads beyond; determined from device position on every graph replay
dispatch.short_path: retained for fallbacks; eligible new dispatch takes precedence

build.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=20G nice ionice -c3 ninja -C build -j10 strata-q36 q36_attn_rows
